findings.text: The difference is not simply "facts versus opinions"—opinion writing can use facts, and news reporting can include analysis. The stronger clue is whether the text's primary function is reporting/expla
A news report may say, "Officials estimate the policy will raise ₱2 million annually." An opinion piece may argue, "The policy unfairly burdens working families and should be repealed."
